Class CLIHelper

java.lang.Object
lms.presentation.CLIHelper
public final class CLIHelper extends Object
Utility class providing reusable CLI helper methods for formatting and user interaction.

Contains static methods for printing headers, messages, handling user input, and displaying search results. Used by UserCLI, AdminCLI, and other CLI classes to maintain consistent formatting.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Majd Awwad

      public static <T> T findItemBySearchTerm(List<T> items, String searchTerm, String itemType, Function<T,String> titleGetter, Function<T,String> authorGetter, Function<T,UUID> idGetter, Consumer<List<T>> displayFunction, Scanner scanner)
      Finds an item from a list by searching through title, author, or ID. Handles exact matches, partial matches, and multiple match selection.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of items to search
      Parameters:
      items - the list of items to search through
      searchTerm - the term to search for
      itemType - the type name for display purposes
      titleGetter - function to extract title from item
      authorGetter - function to extract author from item
      idGetter - function to extract ID from item
      displayFunction - function to display list of items
      scanner - the scanner for reading user input
      Returns:
      the found item, or null if not found or cancelled
